selected_evidence.requirement: Restore a legacy-platform-compatible delivery entry point
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 platform was identified; the repaired root-owned mode-0755 POSIX shell script passed syntax checks and remained installed after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Route accounts, support, and unmatched messages correctly with case-insensitive header names
selected_evidence.summary: The canonical-case accounts header and lowercase support header routed to their respective Maildirs; mail without the header routed to general.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve delivered messages byte-for-byte and keep repeated subjects separate
selected_evidence.summary: Each delivered file matched its source with `cmp` and SHA-256; two general deliveries with the same subject had distinct filenames.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain staged samples and clean test residue
selected_evidence.summary: Final sample hashes and permissions match the baseline. Only generated test deliveries were removed, and they remain reproducible from the retained samples.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release, kernel, services, and security controls
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained installed; SELinux stayed enforcing and management/SSH services recovered active.

Healthy baseline boot ID 7217fc31-8b1e-4097-936b-13f98cd8a5df was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID f101f750-7b7e-4594-9608-edf8d00fe521 was observed, and services, script, samples, security state, and delivery behavior recovered.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
umask 022
mkdir -p "$base/Maildir/tmp" \
         "$base/Maildir/accounts/new" "$base/Maildir/accounts/cur" \
         "$base/Maildir/support/new" "$base/Maildir/support/cur" \
         "$base/Maildir/general/new" "$base/Maildir/general/cur"

tmp=$(mktemp "$base/Maildir/tmp/deliver.XXXXXXXXXX")
cleanup()
{
    if [ -n "${tmp:-}" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$tmp"
    fi
}
trap cleanup 0 HUP INT TERM

cat > "$tmp"

department=$(awk '
{
    line = $0
    sub(/\r$/, "", line)
    if (line == "")
        exit
    colon = index(line, ":")
    if (colon == 0)
        next
    name = substr(line, 1, colon - 1)
    if (tolower(name) != "x-department")
        next
    value = substr(line, colon + 1)
    sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", value)
    sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", value)
    print tolower(value)
    exit
}
' "$tmp")

case "$department" in
    accounts) mailbox=accounts ;;
    support)  mailbox=support ;;
    *)        mailbox=general ;;
esac

name=$(basename -- "$tmp")
target="$base/Maildir/$mailbox/new/$name"
ln -- "$tmp" "$target"
rm -f -- "$tmp"
tmp=
trap - 0 HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_DELIVER_EOF
sh -n /tmp/mail-filter-deliver.new
install -o root -g root -m 0755 /tmp/mail-filter-deliver.new bin/deliver
restorecon -F bin/deliver 2>/dev/null || true
